itemLimits.note: the item contracts' caps: slots in a pack and in the bank, the most of one stackable in a stack, the highest upgrade level, and the most a loot table's currency range may name

economyLimits.note: the trade/service contracts' caps: the most coin in one trade, the most lines in one side's offer, material lines on one upgrade request, and material instances one upgrade may burn

storyLimits.note: the quest contract's caps: the largest single state change a quest step may make, and the most stages one quest may have

worldLimits.note: a faction's standing runs from min to max, and a faction has at most this many ranks
